result.response:
# Nettle CI — Black Friday 2026 Campaign Recap

The Black Friday campaign (`bzftj`) ran across the full nine-day window from **Saturday 21 November 2026 (00:00 GMT)** through **Sunday 29 November 2026 (23:59 GMT)**, targeting strictly the **United Kingdom and Ireland** with `audience_expansion=DEFINED` so no impressions leaked outside your supported regions.

---

## Overall Summary

| Metric | Total |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Total Spend** | **$494.37 USD** *(out of $500.00 budget — 98.9% utilization)* |
| **Impressions** | **319,050** |
| **Link Clicks** | **154** |
| **Total Engagements** | **1,978** |
| **Average Cost per Link Click (CPC)** | **$3.21 USD** |
| **Link Click-Through Rate (CTR)** | **0.048%** |

---

## Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)

Because X had no conversion pixel installed on `nettleci.co.uk`, all line items were configured with the `WEBSITE_CLICKS` objective (`goal=LINK_CLICKS`, `pay_by=LINK_CLICK`) to optimize directly for high-intent landing page visits.

| Line Item ID | Ad Group Name | Status | Impressions | Link Clicks | Engagements | Spend (USD) | Avg CPC |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `zi7g2` | **UK+IE - CI/CD & DevOps Keywords** *(GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Jenkins, CI/CD, flaky tests, red build, build pipeline)* | Completed (Ran Days 1–9) | 126,024 | 61 | 887 | $195.21 | $3.20 |
| `eynum` | **UK+IE - Winning Creatives - Software Dev & CI/CD** *(Combined top keywords + Software Dev interest, top 3 posts only)* | Completed (Ran Days 4–9) | 106,525 | 58 | 731 | $190.22 | $3.28 |
| `cirm4` | **UK+IE - Software Dev & QA Roles/Interests** *(Software Dev interest + DevOps, platform engineering, QA engineer, test automation)* | Completed (Ran Days 1–9) | 65,515 | 35 | 450 | $108.94 | $3.11 |
| `r3zhe` | **UK+IE - Desktop Tech & Followers** *(Desktop-only + follower lookalikes)* | Paused after Day 1 | 20,986 | 0 | 142 | $0.00 | — |
| **Total** | | | **319,050** | **154** | **1,978** | **$494.37** | **$3.21** |

---

## Performance by Approved Post (Creative)

Across all ad groups, the problem-led question (`2123566994028154923`) and urgency-led deadline copy (`2123748187962542190`) drove the strongest click volume and highest click-through rates, while the pricing-first copy (`2123385800094755076`) lagged significantly.

| Post ID | Copy Preview | Impressions | Link Clicks | Link CTR | Engagements | Spend (USD) | Avg CPC |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `2123566994028154923` | *"Be honest: how many times did you hit 'rerun job' this week?..."* | 96,580 | **55** | **0.057%** | 652 | $178.96 | $3.25 |
| `2123748187962542190` | *"Until Sunday 29 November only: sign up to Nettle CI and get 60 days..."* | 98,288 | **52** | **0.053%** | 656 | $183.88 | $3.54 |
| `2123204606163673400` | *"Nettle CI scores every test in your pipeline for flakiness..."* | 88,928 | **39** | **0.044%** | 653 | $106.71 | $2.74 |
| `2123385800094755076` | *"£0 for 60 days. That's the Nettle CI Team plan this Black Friday week..."* | 35,254 | **8** | **0.023%** | 259 | $24.82 | $3.10 |
| **Total** | | **319,050** | **154** | **0.048%** | **1,978** | **$494.37** | **$3.21** |

---

## Daily Pacing & Optimization Log

| Date (2026) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Daily Spend | Cumulative Spend | Active Management & Adjustments |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | :--- |
| **Sat 21 Nov** | 40,376 | 12 | $41.96 | $41.96 | Launched 3 initial ad groups (`zi7g2`, `cirm4`, `r3zhe`) with all 4 posts across UK & Ireland. |
| **Sun 22 Nov** | 36,867 | 17 | $48.88 | $90.84 | Paused `r3zhe` (20.9k impressions, 0 link clicks on Day 1) and reallocated budget to `zi7g2` and `cirm4`. |
| **Mon 23 Nov** | 42,348 | 19 | $49.44 | $140.28 | Added `red build`, `build pipeline`, and `flaky test` keywords to `zi7g2` and raised weekday budgets. |
| **Tue 24 Nov** | 40,656 | 17 | $48.01 | $188.28 | Launched `eynum` combining top CI/CD + Software Dev targeting and isolating the top 3 posts (excluding slow-performing `2123385800094755076`). |
| **Wed 25 Nov** | 34,758 | 19 | $69.25 | $257.54 | Expanded `eynum` keywords (`continuous integration`, `test automation`, `build pipeline`) and scaled daily budget ahead of Black Friday. |
| **Thu 26 Nov** | 31,755 | 22 | $77.49 | $335.03 | Peak pre-Black Friday traffic (22 link clicks). Increased daily cap on `eynum` and `zi7g2` for Black Friday. |
| **Fri 27 Nov** *(Black Friday)* | 25,070 | 12 | $49.63 | $384.65 | Tuned weekend pacing across `eynum`, `zi7g2`, and `cirm4` to preserve budget for the final 48-hour deadline push. |
| **Sat 28 Nov** | 34,624 | 18 | $59.04 | $443.69 | Shifted remaining budget weight toward `eynum` and `zi7g2` where urgency and pain-point copy performed best. |
| **Sun 29 Nov** *(Final Day)* | 33,555 | 18 | $50.69 | $494.37 | Final offer deadline push; campaign paused cleanly at 00:00 GMT on 30 Nov at $494.37 total spend. |
